summary_1line: Drona forms an impenetrable array after luring Arjuna away; Abhimanyu breaks in, fights heroically, and is slain by multiple Kaurava warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Young Abhimanyu drives his chariot into Drona’s blazing circular battle array, breaking the ring of warriors and banners.
Six veteran Kaurava warriors surround the lone Abhimanyu as his shattered chariot stands amid fallen soldiers.
At sunset after the carnage, blood-soaked warriors stare across the field while the sun sinks behind the western hills.
